summary: Fixed do_indent in filters.py so the trailing-newline quirk applies to plain strings as well as Markup, which makes test_indent pass, and named the async_variant wrapper after its async function (module, qualname, name) in async_utils.py so Environment pickles by reference, which makes test_pickle::test_environment pass. The last full-suite run I saw was 850 passed and 1 failed; the remaining failure is test_loader.py::TestFileSystemLoader::test_caches_template_based_on_mtime, a PermissionError from os.utime on a root-owned fixture file in the jail, not a source issue.
